summary.headline: Ptolemy and Theophilus Excerpts
summary.text: Catalog of folios containing Claudius Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos, Book of the Fruit, and hypotheses of the wandering stars, followed by astrological excerpts attributed to Theophilus on co-rising stars, solar and lunar eclipses, initiatives, poisoning, twelfth-parts, demon-possession, robbers, death, lunar applications and separations, and attacking enemies. Cross-references identify Florentine, Venetian, Paris, and Vindobon codices.
